book.name: Malaka
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Malaka byex o

content: Qayeeng pakeing en vuweing lulul vei eivek xuk

Yesu lox teyoxe xel qendu ngandoung wei qekuma is e yon no nanghei lounyeing nenyawes. Inyon xel qendu ngandoung wei nale wou e ma yon ngenong, om moxo la eivek bot lek lounyeing me la dei dom xel xomaxoneing dalus on toungale wou lounyeing nenyawes.
Om moxo di teyoxe xel en lul ngenong eivek qayeeng pakeing, me eivek e xe teyoxeing eno inye,
“Ngo! Xuk ma ti la en embei na davuw e xe lulul vei eivek xuk.
Ka moxo di vuw lulul vei lala, valu teila wou sakwaing, me menek lam ya ema.
De valu teila lek qakous qakous, wei tembuing nimza maeing, om lulul vei yon vindek lam daing, nambei tembuing on se la ghembi.
Ekom gyeik sayeiv leklam, lulul vei wei tyip on eno sayeiv leis om xel mey en nambei xel luselis ma.
De vei valu teila eivek qeis wei yingying, wei ling me leklam apu me nale zeyi lul tyipeing, om xel se vuk neing.
De vei valu teila lek tembuing nimza om tyip me lam apu, ling ngandoung me vuk neing ngenong nambei xoumeeng yal (30), 60 me 100.”
Woyom Yesu neil, “Eti nenya toundei lek e bei e ngo, yond wong e ngo wou qayeeng.”
Gyeik xel qendu ngandoung la veil, de e venaxow toundei eno xel betiyeing xoumeeng yuw me xel ba wei vivekwou e eno teling en qayeeng pakeing beimambei ne.
Moxo neil wou xel, “Anutu xe qayeeng xupekeing wei tete lalei, eno wong wou xam. Ekom wou xel wei toundei myayaing, eno lul dalusateiv a neil eivek qayeeng pakeing.
Om

content.text: “‘xel a mi gyei le ekom tyek xel se gyeiwou,
me na mi ngo, ekom xel se teyeimbei boulek,
wangwei se nambei nyon nei tyek xel pekwi xow me Anutu semaleeng xel xe nilul veil.’”Yesaya 6:9-10

content: Woyom Yesu neil wou xel, “Beip xam seng woulek qayeeng pakeing tine? Woyom nambei nya tyek xam ghe boulek qayeeng pakeing dalus?
Tambiy wei mema xuk eno vuw Anutu xe xoulek.
Xomaxoneing valu eno nambei vei wei teila lek sakwaing, wei xel vuw xoulek, gyeik kawei xel ngo yo, Sandang lam me zeim xoulek wei xel xen eivek xel eno veil.
De xel valu eno nambei vei wei xel vuw xoulek lek qakous qakous o, xel ngo xoulek me lutika eno xel qou is xeindlala.
Ekom xel xe luselis eno ma, xel nale teyei lek seivma nayaka. Gyeik ingwei nimaying o xomaxoneing wo nol wou xel, en ingwei xel betiwou Anutu xe xoulek, om xel nind wongeingis eno tei daing.
Xel valu nambei vei wei xel vuw eivek yis wei niying o. Xel ngo xoulek,
ekom xel wo laleind maying en mapieing tine, kwa wei embei bo lulul ana eno mi tyoxe xel, me woueing nalei en lul valu lam eivek me nale zeyi xoulek, om se wo neing.
Ekom xel valu, eno nambei vei wei xel vuw lek tembuing aneing wei nimza yo, om xel ngo xoulek me laleind vind om xel vuk neing teyei lek xoumeeng yal (30), 60 me 100 inyon vati wei xel ev o.”
Qayeeng pakeing en lam
Moxo neil wou xel, “Beip wang qou lam me ghe lam bei toung eivek dengmuing lalei o lelek xeinghembi? Ma, wa toung lek vaxa wei mi nale lek o?
En vatiyeiw wei dei xupekeing, eno tyek nam yanyateiv, de vatiyeiw wei yeip xupekeing eno tyek xel a qou me nam myayaing.
Wangwei xelti nenya toundei lek e bei e ngo, ond wong e ngo wou qayeeng.”

Om moxo neil wou xel, “Xam a ni nenyam wou vati wei xam a bei ngo yo eno xam ghe bou naleimim en embo nimza. Vamva wei xam ghe ngo yo eno tyek Anutu bong lupeyei vamva yon noum wou xam me tyek bong lupeyei valu lek mapu wou xam is.
De wangwei eti na qou lupeyei, ond tyek na qou lupeyei valu lek mapu is. Dom wangwei eti se qou lupeyei ond tyek lupeyei kawei qou yo eno tyek na zeim veil e.”
Qayeeng pakeing en lul vei wei tyipeing o
De Yesu neil no, “Tete lalei wei Anutu yo, teyei lek ambei moux ti vuw vei lala lek tembuing.
Boukeing me bendiyeing eno moxo mi yeip o qandi lek, de vei wei xen eno tyip me ling ambei nya eno se woulek.
Tembuing venaxow wong lul on tyip, yateiv belup atax dekakom wo lis lek, de woyom vuk neing lek lu.
Dekalekom gyeik neing wo ngandoung me zuw, eno moxo zeim ngeyeing wou en nambei inye bouk wei qoueing neing o.”
Qayeeng pakeing en mastet aneing
De Yesu neil no, “Tyek xey a boulek Anutu xe tete lalei eno nambei nya? O tyek xey a neil qayeeng pakeing vati en e neilteyei?
Inye nambei mastet vei, vei ne nayakamaing ka veil vei wei wang mi xen eivek tembuing o.
Ka gyeik eveing o, ling me wo teta me wo ngandoungateiv ghanaw lulul dalus wei eveing eivek xuk on, is mema ngandoung, inyon menek menek tyek nam bako lewis eivek e xe senyoleeng.”
Yesu luk qayeeng pakeing ngenong is xoulek wou xel, teyeimbei xel a ngo wou.
Moxo se neil luti wou xel, qe di neil qayeeng sapa yon eivek qayeeng pakeing. Ekom gyeik e venaxow mindei is e xe xel betiyeing eno moxo mi neil lul dalus yeip yaing wou xel.
Yesu neil dom laweeng valeivek ma
Lek bouk kayon gyeik soukeing di lam, eno moxo neil wou e xe xel betiyeing, “Xey ambei na nge loxalu nei.”
Xel ghanaw xomaxoneing qendu ngandoung on dom xel qou e me la lek bot tiwei Yesu toundei lek o. Inyon bot valu la is xel.
De inyon laweeng valeivek ti tyip, me mamileeng di vuklek me lam leislek bot me embim a puplek.
Yesu toundei eivek bot leyus, me di yeip lek pilo. Xel betiyeing piyexe e me neil wou e, “Putoung, inyon wa seng pyanaleim en ingwei xey a bim a mey ne?”
Moxo qandi lek me luk nikanzek wou laweeng de neil wou mamileeng wei di vuk me lam on, “Denduing ma! Dom weip kanzek!” Woyom laweeng mey de mamileeng yeip kanzek.
E neil wou xel betiyeing, “Nambei nya ekom xam ghe waleeng? Beip xam seng ghei wongis?”
Xel yaleeng ngandoung me teling wouma, “Tambiy tine eti? Omek laweeng me mamileeng ngo e vya ne!”
